# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RECLAIM_WITH_RSI_DIVERGENCE_AND_VOLUME_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-09-11

## Hypothesis

A VWAP reclaim accompanied by bullish RSI divergence and above-average volume signals strong buying pressure after weakness, capturing mean-reversion momentum. The filter aims to improve entry quality by requiring confluence of VWAP reclamation, RSI bullish divergence, volume expansion, and higher-low market structure.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Price crosses above VWAP (from below) on a candle closing above VWAP, RSI(14) shows bullish divergence (price makes lower low, RSI makes higher low over last 4 candles), volume on reclaim candle > 1.3 * average volume of prior 15 candles, and market structure shows a higher low (HL) formation. Additionally, VIX between 18-28, time after 10:00 AM ET, and no VIX spike >0.5 points in 5 minutes.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at prior swing low or 0.7*ATR below entry, whichever is tighter. Initial target at 1:1 reward-risk (50% position). Remainder trailed by 12% of ATR from high-water mark using a premium-stop (chandelier style).
